Seat reading on the dev's report 7071036267 (PR #36215, `Part of #35612`): what stays on this card.

- Item 4 (post-merge split leg) stays here, not on a new card: it is this card's own ordered work, so it is executed, not re-asked. The dev measured it at roughly arm-leg size (about 300 lines with tests) and kept it out of #36215 on scope. It is built in a second PR on this card after #36215 lands. Until then the weekly sweep keeps every `.claude/**` merge on the maintainer's recognition list: over-inclusive, never hiding a landing.
- One finding from the same review is folded here (dedupe `lowRiskRecordStageReasons` / `record leg` / `Security-touching`: 3 hits, the only open one is this card, held by this seat, so it is a comment and not a card). In `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`, `lowRiskRecordStageReasons` does not consult the record leg's verdict. So `--pr` and the relay can read the low-risk skills arm Tier S over a FAIL or below-tier record that the queue's record leg (`lowRiskRecordVerdict`) refuses. This has the same N1 shape #36215 fixes for the rule-change split. Fix: one conjunct, now that the stage carries `recordLeg` for both arms, plus fixture updates. Suggested grade p3, same PR as item 4.
- Not filed: the H43 split record reading only the PR thread (it errs toward under-reporting), and `owedFace` not reading changesets. Both are recorded in #36215's Acceptance notes.
